create_MLP_model: create an MLP neural network with configurable hidden layers and output classes for MNIST classification
build_mnist_model: build a pretrained MNIST classification model using the mnist factory function with default 784 input dims
run_MLP_forward: run a forward pass through the MLP model with an input tensor matching the configured input dimensions
review_MLP_init: review the MLP class constructor to understand how hidden layers, ReLU activations, and dropout are configured
test_mnist_pretrained: test loading a pretrained MNIST model weights from the model zoo URL into an MLP instance
